name: Verdant Meal #27
description:
Contained within the pouch is a compact serving of green gel-like sustenance. Upon opening, the gel emits spores that induce plant growth in a localized area, regardless of the presence of fertile soil.

EFFECT: Upon opening, the meal causes a small area around it to experience accelerated plant growth, producing greenery at an unnatural pace.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: Rapid plant growth observed in close proximity to the opened container.
TASTE: The meal has a vegetal, fresh taste reminiscent of leafy greens and herbs.
PACKAGING: A green retort pouch with illustrated futuristic landscapes featuring massive trees and lush vegetation. The words "Verdant Meal" appear below the image in bold, stylized glyphs.

RESEARCHER NOTE: Potentially useful for terraforming, though not so much for a home garden unless overgrown is the goal.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-11-23 — edition #27 of the permanent record.
